column1: # Jawwid Chat environment-variable manifest. Owner: AI #7 (infrastructure).
# The single machine-readable source of truth for configuration. Consumed by
# scripts/infra/check-env.sh, which CI and every deployment run.
#   SECRET   yes = must come from the secret store, never from a tracked file
#   LOCAL    req | opt | forbid   -- state required in local development
#   PROD     req | opt | forbid   -- forbid = deployment is refused if present
# `forbid` is not decoration. DEBUG-style switches are forbidden in production
# so that "temporarily enable it to debug prod" is a deliberate change to this
# file and its review, not a console edit nobody sees.
# STORAGE. Two kinds of row live here, and the difference matters when reading
# Read by the implementation that exists today: STORAGE_SIGNING_SECRET (the API
# refuses to start without it), STORAGE_ENDPOINT, STORAGE_SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS,
# Reserved for the S3-compatible backend the seam is built for: STORAGE_REGION,
# STORAGE_BUCKET, STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY, STORAGE_SECRET_KEY. No code reads these
# yet -- OBJECT_STORAGE is bound to the reference SignedLocalObjectStorage and no
# adapter exists (findings.md RT-022). They stay declared because this file
# states the deployment contract rather than the current call graph, exactly as
# the APNS_* rows do while FCM carries iOS through its own APNs bridge, and
# because docker-compose.yml already provisions the local S3-compatible service
# they configure. Deleting them would take the local stack and inventory.md with
# them. No provider has been chosen; nothing here chooses one.
# Where the local reference blob store keeps bytes. Optional everywhere because
# the code defaults it (blob-store.ts) -- but the default is the OS temp
# directory, which no deployment should rely on: it is per-instance and does not
# survive a restart. Setting this names a path; it does not make that path
# durable or shared. Durability is a hosting decision, not a manifest one.
# Ceiling on the duration a sender may claim for a voice note. The server never
# decodes the audio, so this bounds an assertion rather than a measurement.
# Read by FcmPushProvider. Without both, PUSH_PROVIDER binds the logging
# provider instead and nothing is sent -- which is why they are required outside
# local development. FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON is the service-account file Google
# hands out, pasted unmodified: taking it apart into separate variables is how
